forecasts.interpretation: repeat the 168-hour forecast cyclically for every one of four simulated scheduling scenarios, not real/observed subsequent-week carbon intensity

selection_rationale: Alibaba v2023 mean modeled makespan is approximately 308 hours, exceeding the 168-hour frozen forecast. A consistent explicit periodic replay is a controlled counterfactual assumption across all scenarios.
carbon_objective: modeled GPU-side time-integrated energy-weighted forecast intensity in gCO2e/kWh
additional_reporting_metric: modelled total carbon exposure grams CO2e from energy x time-varying intensity

no complete 13 algorithm x 30 seeds x 4 scenarios carbon-v2 experiment results
constraint/decoder carbon feasibility remains optimizer-iteration-indexed while f3 is execution-time-aligned
simulator does not enforce simultaneous aggregate CPU capacity
original traces are not historical measurements of UK regional electricity use
workload-activity-based GPU-side power excludes inactive idle and host power

selected forecast period may not be representative of different seasonal intensity
